commit.description: Source commit the binary was built from.

uncommitted_changes.description: True if the binary was built from a working tree with uncommitted changes, so it does not exactly match commit.

go.description: Go toolchain the binary was built with, e.g. go1.25.1.

task.description: The one task file format version this binary reads and writes.

root.description: The one ftask.json format version this binary reads and writes.
